notes.title: Next Chapter of Ashes of the Night, Wormskull April 10th Release
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153200/Wormskull/

Following in the wake of the much enjoyed RPG Ashes of the Night, Wormskull emerges as prequel of its predecessor.
Main Characters Duncan and Maduin take lead in this adventure, in constant haste with impending doom chasing them everywhere they go.
